body:
DELIVERED (admission gating + high-water withholding) + codex-reviewed; retention clause split to pqueue-41bf00d7.
Commits 680e5d1d (wire) + ed0507f2 (codex-review fixes).

WIRED FOR REAL: HybridAsyncMonitor + Config::hybrid_async thresholds threaded into the server's hybrid-async
write path (lib.rs:1666 with_async_monitor, armed ONLY in the hybrid-async arm; hybrid/hybrid-strict/sqlite/
inmemory pass None → unchanged, codex-confirmed). Monitor observes GENUINE deferred-checkpoint backlog
(observe_async_debt folds deferred_commands on real apply_live/apply_live_owned/apply_recovery + drains on
flush_deferred) — not a test poke (codex-confirmed).

PROVEN on the real composed backend (ComposedBackend<ObjectLog, HybridProjectionStore(+monitor), ...>):
- Hard-debt mutating admission FAILS CLOSED with typed EngineError::Unavailable, 0 extra durable commands
  (ac_txn_5a_hard_debt_fails_mutating_admission — asserts durable_command_count + projected pending unchanged).
- Idempotent replay is admission-SAFE: gate moved AFTER the idempotency Replay/Conflict check (compose.rs:2309),
  so a same-body retry of an already-committed request_id REPLAYS its ids (adds 0 debt) even under Hard debt; a
  brand-new request_id is rejected Unavailable (ac_txn_5a_idempotent_replay_admitted_under_debt). [Fixes a real
  correctness bug codex caught: the original gated before replay and wrongly rejected idempotent retries.]
- recovery_high_water WITHHELD (None) while Hard, advances strictly past the seed once debt drains below the
  release band (ac_txn_5a_debt_withholds_high_water_and_retention — real observable path).
GATED SET (TD-004:367 "new mutating operations"): push, push_with_request_id (proceed path), claim (non-empty) —
the ops that ADD async-apply debt. NOT gated: finalize/renew/reassign/reclaim/update (complete/recover in-flight
work; TD-004 clears debt by DRAINING, blocking completion would stall the lifecycle) — documented on the
admit_mutation trait doc.

HONEST RESIDUAL (retention advancement → row is PARTIAL, split): the reap gate IS genuinely wired
(ProjectionStore::retention_may_advance consulted by reap_terminal_items_locked; HybridProjectionStore overrides
to the monitor, fail-closed under Hard). BUT objectlog/hybrid-async implements NO retention-ADVANCEMENT path to
gate (no reap_terminal_items override; object-log segment expiry/trim unimplemented), so retention withholding
can't be proven end-to-end for this backend. Recorded as a precise GAP (not faked) → AC-TXN-5A row PARTIAL.
Split to pqueue-41bf00d7 (implement objectlog/hybrid-async retention-advancement + prove the backpressure clause).

Codex adversarial review: admission gate placement + typed error SOUND; genuine-debt observation SOUND; high-water
withholding SOUND; non-async profiles unchanged SOUND; store-wide monitor acceptable conservative fail-closed SOUND;
the replay-ordering correctness bug + retention overclaim it caught are both fixed (replay-safe gate; honest retention GAP).
Verify (independent re-run, 0 failed): cargo test -p pqueue-conformance ac_txn_5a → 4 passed; cargo test
-p pqueue-server -p pqueue-sqlite -p pqueue-conformance → all 0 failed.

Closing this bead for the delivered admission-gating + high-water-withholding scope (the bead's primary intent);
the retention-advancement clause, blocked on unimplemented object-log segment expiry, is tracked in pqueue-41bf00d7.
summary: hybrid-async admission gating (push+claim, replay-safe) + high-water withholding wired & proven; retention split to pqueue-41bf00d7 (row partial)
